lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct white vertical line segments are visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is broader on the anterior section and decreases in frequency toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A prominent Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 8th line segment (counting from the shoulder) at the mid-lateral vertical midpoint.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 5 and line 10 exhibit significant fragmentation, appearing as a series of dashed blobs rather than continuous linear segments. Line 11 terminates abruptly before reaching the dorsal crest.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of three distinct circular white spots is visible on the mid-posterior haunch, positioned above the white inguinal band.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The three haunch spots align in a near-vertical geometric orientation, though they remain spatially distinct.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horn exhibits a spiral lyrate trajectory, emerging from the skull at an approximate 70-degree upward angle before curving posteriorly and then spiraling inward toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The ivory-colored terminal tip accounts for approximately 1/12th of the total visible vertical height of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots are located on the lower mandible area. A high-contrast white dorsal crest of long hair extends from the nape to the posterior torso.
